title: Novo dips 6% on Wegovy pill stumble despite Q2 earnings beat
snippet: Novo Nordisk’s shares fell 6% on Tuesday afternoon after its second quarter earnings report showed a slight miss for the Wegovy pill vs. consensus.

title: Lisata axes 72% of workforce following failed merger with Kuva
snippet: In addition to laying off employees, including a member of its management team, Lisata Therapeutics is also suing Kuva Labs, alleging the company breached a merger agreement.

title: Pfizer CEO defends $7B bolt-on M&A strategy as peers rush to buy
snippet: Asked on a second quarter earnings call if Pfizer could direct more money to M&A amid a feeding frenzy across the pharma industry, CEO Albert Bourla defended his strategy.

title: Merck’s $10.8B Prometheus deal delivers another win—plus a Phase 2b miss
snippet: The anti-TL1A antibody from Merck's 2023 Prometheus buy delivered positive mid-stage results in a skin condition but failed in a certain type of lung disease, the Big Pharma revealed alongside second-quarter earnings.

title: BioNTech cuts sales forecast on slumping demand for COVID-19 vaccine
snippet: Lower vaccine demand across every market and more acute pressures in Germany led BioNTech to lower the midpoint of its sales outlook by almost 20%.

title: As portfolio erodes, BMS stands to gain a lot from rumored AstraZeneca merger
snippet: While both drugmakers face looming patent cliffs, analysts say joining forces could help Bristol Myers Squibb replenish its eroding portfolio—while the strategic case for AstraZeneca seems to be more mixed.

title: Pfizer cuts $2.5B more across R&D, manufacturing in ongoing restructure
snippet: The additional cuts, which will primarily occur between 2027 and 2029, will cost some $6 billion as the pharma tries to ride out a post-COVID headache while facing stiff patent headwinds for major products like the blood thinner Eliquis.
